plane: ground (horizontal sweep), 270 degree arc in the order of travel A -> B -> C: from the left (behind the body) THROUGH THE FAR SIDE to the right (B), then back round the NEAR side to the viewer (C, the end and the hit); cut between poses, no in-betweens
image: pose_skill_sweep_p1_v02.png (A: hips wound back, blade behind the body pointing LEFT) / pose_skill_sweep_p2_v03.png (B: about two thirds of the way, blade pointing RIGHT and slightly down) / pose_skill_sweep_p3_v01.png (C: the END, blade at the viewer, foreshortened wedge pointing DOWN); 1024x1024 source px, origin top-left, y down
root_a_note: the blade of A vanishes behind the cape at x=393: root_a is the end of the VISIBLE blade (hilt hidden)
pivot_note: torso centre x = middle of the shoulder plates; y of the torso point = shoulder line (for the effect the pivot y is the height of the blade line at that x)
height_note: head top to the mean of the lowest boot pixels (B: left boot 951, right 929)

alignment.policy: feet: scale B by scale_b_to_a about foot_mid_b, then put foot_mid_b on foot_mid_a (planted feet). Everything below in the aligned (A) frame, source px

fit.note: effect built in px @2x = aligned source px * 0.2 (character drawn at 0.2); pivot y = tip height (A) / blade-line height at the torso x minus 14 (B); k 0.22

hit_frame_note: frame 1 = pose A (sliver on the visible blade), frame 2 = pose B (stroke from A through the far half to tip_b), frame 3 = pose C and the hit (full stroke to tip_c), then the stroke fades tail first on body C (15 fps)

pose_c.description: the END of the sweep and the hit: square to the viewer, the blade points at the viewer, foreshortened to a short wedge pointing DOWN from the fists (about 38-40 % of the visible blade of pose B)
pose_c.root_c_note: root_c = where the foreshortened blade leaves the fists/guard; blade wedge length 132 px
pose_c.pivot_c_note: torso centre x = middle of the shoulder plates (x 303..700 at y 260); y = breastplate V (not used by the effect)
pose_c.foot_c_note: boots: left x 183..337 bottom 953, right x 652..813 bottom 952 (level within 1 px)
pose_c.residual_note: C is 6.7 % bigger than A (B is 4.9 % bigger): scaled by 0.9371 about the feet midpoint. After the feet alignment the torso of C sits 51 px left of A's torso and 5.6 px left of B's (aligned source px); the feet of C are level (1 px), B's are 22 px apart

fit_three.note: effect built in px @2x = aligned source px * 0.2; pivot_b y = blade-line height minus 14, pivot_c y = the fists (root_c y); k is NOT given: it is fitted (the k for which the radius of the middle tip B lies on the radius run from A to C at its angle)

sequence_note: order of travel and of the frames (user's definition, 2026-11-14): A (p1) -> B (p2, the blade has travelled about 2/3 of the arc) -> C (p3, the end). tip_a = start, tip_b = middle, tip_c = end in every key below. The earlier round (A -> C -> B, C as the middle) is replaced.

offsets.note: in the order of travel; feet-midpoint alignment kept (scale each still to A's body size about its feet midpoint, put the feet midpoint on A's). Source px for the raw ones, aligned (A) frame source px for the aligned ones
